literal_meaning: ফোলা ভাত বা মুড়ি এবং তার ছোট টুকরো
figurative_meaning_en: Ordinary or utterly insignificant food items
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই উপহারটা মুড়ি-মুড়কির মতো, কোনো মূল্য নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: This gift is like peanuts, worth nothing.
The help he offered was as insignificant as puffed rice bits.
note: Refers to common rural snacks in Bengali culture, emphasizing triviality.
